1. **Title Bar**: The top section displays the title "Menstrual period management" along with the year "2017Year".
2. **Navigation**: There is a back arrow on the top left corner for navigation.
3. **Registration Section**: A section labeled "Tap to register" where users can input or register new data.
4. **Last Time Entry**: Below the registration section, there is a record of the last menstrual period with the date "2017/01/01" and an "end" label.
5. **Save Button**: A "Saved" button is located towards the bottom of the screen, indicating that the data has been saved.
6. **Footer**: The footer contains the text "Woman's DIARY Powered by Kirei-Rhythm" on a pink background.

The overall design is simple and focused on tracking
